reason: A fully local DeepSeek Harness plugin for cross-session memory, recall injection, evolving user context, and reusable skill synthesis using SQLite-based storage and scheduled maintenance.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地跨会话记忆、相关记忆注入、用户画像演化和可复用技能合成功能。
summaries.en: A local DeepSeek Harness plugin that stores and recalls cross-session memories, evolves user context, and synthesizes reusable skills.

capabilities: Captures conversation information into a local SQLite memory store
Extracts, consolidates, decays, corrects, and forgets stored memories
Retrieves relevant memories and injects them into subsequent agent turns
Synthesizes reusable skills from successful workflows
Runs scheduled local maintenance and review tasks
Provides commands and a UI for browsing and managing memories, personas, scenes, and skills
